value.rationale: The invariant is the natural density of two simultaneously occupied record positions, a second-order arithmetic statistic not resolved by known single-position density. Shift six is mathematically canonical from the residues of records modulo six. The certified interval, sign and magnitude of the covariance quantify strong clustering, and the proof establishes effective pair densities at every fixed shift.
